page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 4 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 223 GB SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 1 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that this instance sits in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, consistently place the processor in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth performance is also constrained, with uncached large-block read operations registering at 20.18 GB/sec, categorized in the bottom 10%. Database and web serving benchmarks reflect similar limitations, with static web serving throughput at 2.5 GB/sec and Redis SET operations reaching 2.98 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i1.xlarge offers dedicated CPU allocation and integrated local SSD storage on older-generation hardware. This makes it a viable option for legacy applications, development environments, or lightweight database tasks that require dedicated resources and local storage without demanding high-throughput performance. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and non-critical background processing where resource predictability is preferred over raw computational speed.
